description:
Raised in poverty, Kim Woo-Joon has done every kind of job imaginable just to survive. When he rushes back to his rural hometown after hearing about his mother’s car accident, he is crushed by the impossible weight of hospital bills and daily expenses. Desperate, Woo-Joon stumbles into an interview at a luxurious hotel hidden deep in the countryside, a place that caters to the ultra rich and keeps its most exclusive guests in sealed off VIP rooms. There, he meets the enigmatic owner, Kang Ra-Han, a man whose calm smile hides dangerous intentions. Instead of an ordinary job offer, Ra-Han presents Woo-Joon with a startling contract, one that blurs the line between employment and something far more intimate.

With his mother’s life on the line and no other options left, Woo-Joon must decide how much of himself he is willing to give up in exchange for survival.

(Source: Lezhin US)
